{"id":1885711029,"question_id":3214,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 1 week","timestamp":1768473985,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"1 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1885711029/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximize Area of Square Hole in Grid","memory":"31.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int maximizeSquareHoleArea(int n, int m, vector<int>& hBars, vector<int>& vBars) {\n        int x = hBars.size();\n        int y = vBars.size();\n        sort(hBars.begin() , hBars.end());\n        sort(vBars.begin() , vBars.end());\n\n        int consecheight = 1;\n        int maxheight = 1;\n        int maxwidth = 1;\n        int consecwidth = 1;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i+1<y ; i++)\n        {\n            if(vBars.size() == 1) break;\n            if(vBars[i+1] - vBars[i] == 1)\n            {\n                consecheight++;\n                maxheight = max(maxheight , consecheight);\n            } \n            else consecheight = 1;\n        }\n        for(int i = 0 ; i+1<x ; i++)\n        {\n            if(hBars.size() == 1) break;\n            if(hBars[i+1] - hBars[i] == 1)\n            {\n                consecwidth++;\n                maxwidth = max(maxwidth , consecwidth);\n            } \n            else consecwidth = 1;\n        }\n        \n        int side_req = min(maxwidth , maxheight) + 1;\n        return side_req * side_req;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximize-area-of-square-hole-in-grid","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1488}
